fields.label: Scenario
fields.description: The forecast scenario this declaration is for. A scenario of any other type is refused: a budget scenario has one Cycle per year by rule, and Approved Budget is its declaration.

fields.label: Fiscal Year
fields.description: The fiscal year this declaration covers. It must be the Budget Cycle's year; one live declaration (draft or approved) per scenario and year.

fields.label: Title
fields.description: Set on save: the scenario and the year.

fields.label: Budget Cycle
fields.description: The approved forecast round (a Budget Cycle of this scenario and year) whose figures the year reports: the scenario trial balance, the Excel forecast reads and the cost-allocation pool read this round and no other. It must be approved (not a draft, not cancelled), of this scenario and of this fiscal year.

fields.label: As-of Date
fields.description: Copied from the Budget Cycle: the actuals cut-off the round forecasts from.

fields.label: Horizon (periods)
fields.description: Copied from the declared Budget Cycle: that Cycle's own horizon. The round is cut at the longest horizon among its approved Cycles (konsolidat#376).

fields.label: Rate Set
fields.description: CONSTANT: every forecast translates at its fiscal year's approved Constant rate sheet (konsol#592). Set by the system.

fields.label: Input Fingerprint
fields.description: Copied from the Budget Cycle at submit: the hash of the inputs the round approved. A reader may recompute it and report a change since this declaration; it decides nothing (BUD-11-3).

fields.label: Approved By
fields.description: Set at submit: the user who submitted the declaration (submit is the approval).

fields.label: Approved On
fields.description: Set at submit: when the declaration was submitted, in the site's time zone.

fields.label: Notes
fields.description: Why this round is the current forecast. Optional; Approved By and Approved On record the approval itself.
